title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful. First off I have to say is that it comes very well packed but the inner box that held the tin in , was easy to cut open..but impossible to get out of that box! It fit so tight, I actually had to cut the box to get it out. Now with that said, I love this milk can. It is very lightweight, a good height and looks very farm house sheik.
